dedupe_keys.name: global one kilometre cropland water use efficiency 2001 2020

description: The International Research Center of Big Data for Sustainable Development Goals publishes annual global cropland water-use efficiency for 2001–2020. Twenty GeoTIFF layers provide one-kilometre coverage in EPSG:4326. Efficiency is defined as net primary productivity divided by evapotranspiration, in grams of carbon per kilogram of water per year. The estimates combine ETMonitor evapotranspiration with a light-use-efficiency calculation informed by GLASS and ERA5. Public files are listed without a fee; custom provider terms require attribution and source citation, while the download procedure was not tested. These estimates can inform irrigation and agricultural ecosystem simulations alongside model-invest and data-era5-reanalysis. A caveat is that the carbon-to-water ratio is not irrigation conveyance efficiency or crop yield per unit of applied water. Mixed cropland pixels and modelled respiration affect interpretation.
